title: Reproduce the sealed stone podium exactly on a fresh judged server
goal: Bring up a fresh Minecraft 1.19.2 server from the pinned compose file, wire the MARBLE build_judger pipeline at the pinned sha to it, and have one mineflayer bot reproduce the sealed 10-block Stone Podium blueprint exactly on the judged plot. The judger shifts the blueprint into world space, stocks the material chest, and re-scans the world every ~10 seconds; you must plan the placement order first, poll its snapshot feed to verify progress, repair any mismatched placement it reveals, and re-verify until block_hit_rate reaches 1.0. Keep the honest action and token ledgers the judger requires, or it cannot write the final score.json at all.
resources: docker image itzg/minecraft-server:2024.6.1-java17 (Minecraft 1.19.2 vanilla; compose file assets/gc-360/docker-compose.yml)
docker image node:20.15.1 (Node 20 runtime for mineflayer bots and the judger's JS bridge)
process_expectations: A placement plan artifact (build order + material manifest + chest withdrawal plan) exists before the first block is placed
docker compose up and the judger launch command appear in the run log before any builder bot connects, and load_status.cache is polled to 'loaded' before building starts
Judger snapshots in data/score.json are polled and recorded; every sub-1.0 reading is followed by the identities of mismatched coordinates (expected vs observed block), not just a count
data/action_log.json and data/tokens.json are appended during the run and reflect real bot activity and LLM spend, not a single backfilled entry
